stations.title: Gethin
stations.say: Where did the song requests go?
stations.note: The form posts to an old address.

stations.title: Old address
stations.text: Sends the form on, and fetch follows unseen.

stations.title: Request form
stations.text: Takes song requests sent with POST.

captions: Gethin moved the cupboard server's addresses, and song requests stopped arriving.
The old form address sends each request on, and it arrives with nothing in it.
You name each redirect, see where it leads and follow trails with a limit, in three tasks.
Gethin sees every step from the old address to the form, and where the request went.
A redirect says where to go next. How it says it decides whether your data gets there.
